witness.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d); cp private/witness/core.cpp "$tmp/core.cpp"; python3 -B private/evaluate.py "$tmp"; rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $rc

mutation_check.case: only first half of requested trials contributes

runner: Evaluator uses an independent Python implementation of shared time forcing and evaluates the output of every requested trial. Public tasks specify 1e-10 small, 1e-9 intermediate and 1e-8 required-batch output tolerances.
